feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: US investor Staple Street backs last-gasp German bid for Poundland
articles.summary: A US-based private equity investor is backing a last-gasp German offer to buy Poundland and save the discount retailer from a calamitous pre-Christmas collapse into administration.

articles.title: Football chiefs hold talks in bid to unblock New Deal impasse
articles.summary: The bosses of the Premier League, English Football League (EFL) and the game's watchdog are meeting on Tuesday in a fresh attempt to break the impasse over a landmark financial settlement.

articles.title: Former NatWest chief Rose to leave fintech FNZ
articles.summary: Dame Alison Rose, the former NatWest chief, is leaving the British-based fintech FNZ Group after just a year, amid a deep restructuring which will see close to a quarter of its workforce being cut.

articles.title: Nearly four million in destitution across UK, study suggests
articles.summary: The number of people in destitution across the UK is at a record level, according to new research, as approximately 3.8 million struggled to access basic necessities last year.

articles.title: Capita shares at 35-year low as firm counts cost of civil service pension failures
articles.summary: Capita shares plunged more than 70% on Monday after the UK-based outsourcer revealed plans for a cash call amid an expected slump in profits linked to its troubled Civil Service pension scheme contract.

articles.title: M&S checks out of European stores in franchising shift
articles.summary: Marks & Spencer (M&S) is to transfer its remaining wholly owned international stores to new franchise partners as part of a shift under Stuart Machin, the group's boss.

articles.title: Martin Property Group makes last-gasp pitch to seal Poundland rescue
articles.summary: The Northern Irish company which has been attempting to seal a solvent rescue of Poundland for more than six weeks has made a last-gasp plea to its owner to engage in talks on a deal which could save thousands of high street jobs.

articles.title: Defence investor GALLOS unveils latest bet with critical infrastructure risk start-up
articles.summary: A defence investor which counts Sir Jeremy Fleming, the former GCHQ director, among its advisors will this week unveil its latest start-up bet: a business focused on mapping risk across the supply chains of critical infrastructure operators.

articles.title: Reform treasurer Candy eyes fresh rebirth for augmented reality firm Blippar
articles.summary: Nick Candy, the Reform UK honorary treasurer, is plotting a fresh rebirth of Blippar, the augmented reality business, after orchestrating a deal to reacquire its assets and technology.

articles.title: German bidder stages last-gasp bid to rescue Poundland
articles.summary: A German investment firm has made a last-minute entry into the race to save Poundland, just days before its directors face the bleak prospect of appointing administrators to one of Britain's biggest high street retailers.
